text:
anya: I opened a small PR to refresh the Quickstart hello-world flow: clarify auth, add a one-line curl check, include a tiny Vercel serverless example using an ephemeral token, and modernize one SDK snippet to the v8 client. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5422 (WIP).
mike: can you split SDK changes into a separate commit? makes reviews easier to revert.
tess: add a minimal curl under 'Test locally' so folks can rule out network issues; that's what most new users try first.
anya: will add this curl example:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello from curl"}'
```
mike: include a one-liner about pinning model versions in examples to avoid silent regressions (e.g., model: "redwood/gpt-small:2025-01-01").
tess: small nit: keep env var name consistent as REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere.
anya: noted. I'll also add a short Docker tip to remind folks to EXPOSE 3000 and run with `-e REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
deploy-bot: preview build queued for PR 5422 (ETA ~7m).
mike: add local smoke test steps: `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl. mention clearing KV cache if outputs look stale during iterative testing.
anya: added smoke test and a short troubleshooting section (check env var, expired key, port mapping). Fixed broken deploy link to /docs/deploy/quickstart. Waiting on preview then will merge after CI.
deploy-bot: preview for PR 5422 finished (status: success) - https://deploy-preview-5422--docs.redwood.ai
mike: will review SDK commit later; if green open follow-up issue to migrate remaining snippets.
tess: LGTM from onboarding UX perspective. short and scannable.
anya: thanks all :tada: merging after CI passes. Closing thread.
